mechanics.claim: While enveloped, Nilah becomes ghosted and dodges all non-turret basic attacks, avoiding their damage entirely.
Nilah's cooldown for Jubilant Veil starts only after the effect ends, not on cast.
An individual ally can only be enveloped by Jubilant Veil once every 6 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Allies may only be affected by ''Jubilant Veil'' once every 6 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Jubilant Veil's cooldown is not reduced by Spear of Shojin's Dragonforce stacking effect, a known bug.
mechanics.quote: ''Jubilant Veil's'' cooldown is not affected by {{ii|Spear of Shojin}} {{sbc|Dragonforce}}.
